highlights: Ugreen SC-SC Single-Mode Patchcord Optical Fiber 3m Network Yellow (70664 NW131)

A patch cord is a section of a single-mode fiber optic cable. It is terminated on both sides with an SC connector and has a length of 3 m. The SC connector type is the most popular type at the moment due to the easy snap connection and the rectangular cross-section, which allows the connectors to be densely packed on the panel.
This cable is characterized by low loss and high quality ferrule. Each piece undergoes a quality control.
A single-mode optical fiber with a lowered water peak was used. This ensures compatibility and the ability to perform fully correct fiber optic splices with the existing fiber optic network.
Attenuation: 0.4 dB / km - 1310 nm / 0.25 dB / km - 1550 nm
